content_fields.title: Fine-tune HTTP server settings
content_fields.description: Run the application server with production settings: no auto-reload, multiple workers and explicit request timeouts and concurrency limits.
content_fields.finding: The server is started with --reload and a single worker and no request/keep-alive timeouts or concurrency limits configured.
content_fields.current_code:
web:
    build: .
    command: bash -c "alembic upgrade head && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8091 --workers 1 --reload"
    volumes:
      - ./app/:/app/
    ports:
      - 8091:8091
criteria: `--reload` does not appear in any non-development compose profile.
Keep-alive, concurrency and max-request limits are set explicitly.
The server binds to the internal interface only.
